description.p: Plaza is an eight-voice synthesizer with an ensemble chorus, a big modulated reverb, a cassette stage and a slow + pitch down switch. Play it from the computer keyboard or a USB MIDI keyboard, and record what you play as WAV files in your Music folder.
Everything is synthesized; there are no samples, and Plaza makes no network connections.

A .deb package for Ubuntu, Zorin OS, Linux Mint and Pop!_OS. Linux sound now goes through PulseAudio or PipeWire's PulseAudio service, so Plaza also starts on Ubuntu 22.04 and the distros built on it.
Sound Pack 1: six mid-80s synth-pop presets, Glasshouse Poly, Night Bus Seq, Towpath Bass, Redbrick Strings, Overcast Brass and Platform Bell.
